notes.title: Forest Ranger Patch 1.6
notes.notes:
Hello Rangers!
Due to the bugs you reported, we have decided to update the current version of the game, which fixes some of the bugs you reported. You can find the list of fixed things below! In addition, the reported bugs we will try to fix also welcome reports, including those related to changes in gameplay.

[previewyoutube=NlfBGVcu9y0;full][/previewyoutube]


[Fixed]
[list]
[*] Bug reporter restored (IMPORTANT: If there is a problem with the record please attach the last record and log file)
[*] Corrected display of German and French in ForestWiki
[*] Fixed bug with entering the pop-up menu near the computer
[*] There is no longer an effect on the screen after the hunger bar drops.
[*] Added audio effects after hunger bar drop.
[*] Added notifications after hunger bar drop and thirst bar drop.
[*] Rebalanced and reduced hunger and thirst consumption.
[*] Visual changes to the timer for the start of the tourist season.
[*] Fixed bug with timer stopping when entering the store.
[/list]


In the near future, an update will be added to improve performance and allow gameplay with a gamepad. 

Hope to hear from you soon!

notes.title: Major Update #8
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hello Rangers! 🤠[/h3][/b]

It's been just 1  month since the last major update. Here is the second one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/bda24c3c0c22db518a8f0957d014f3838f42be0c.png[/img]

[h3][b]WHAT WE HAVE ADDED:[/b][/h3]

- New inventory panel in the " Equipment" pop-up menu
- Items can be placed in the inventory by moving them around 
- Items remember their position when loaded. 
- Radial menu - removal of old inventory. Selection of items in the radial menu by default under the "Y" key. 
- Assigning items in the inventory tab to a specific slot in the radial menu. 
- Possibility to move items/pull items between slots - there is a summary of how many items are in the inventory in the slot. 
- Radial menu opening animations
- A pop-up menu in the inventory under the right mouse button. Allows you to manage your inventory and slots in the Radial Menu.
- Currently selected item - default "E" key in quick selection - all items of a given type are available immediately
- Key assignment in operations - main keys for controlling the character and driving.
- +2 new notifications for - collecting honey, fire appearing in the forest - notifications have their own animation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/e8deac2a64bfe8b6c09273fe1f8aacef26d16617.png[/img]

[h3][b]WHAT'S BEEN FIXED[/b][/h3]

- Hive fill level after loading game materials.
- Increased time to eat bird food. The food dispenser in the game is filled
- Bug with the too low display of notifications fixed
- Improved loading of notifications.

Btw. Have you seen that Farmer's Life had recently a 0.9 update? What does it mean? The full release is coming. Wishlist now to be the first to know about the release.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life/

Have a great time playing,
Forest Ranger Simulator team.
